(2) The scene shifts to a kitchen where he presents a clear plastic container of cooked beef and a blue package of Vietnamese spring roll paper against a background of white cabinetry. (3) He is seen in a medium shot at a wooden cutting board, slicing the beef with a kitchen knife, then chopping cucumbers and preparing fresh lettuce leaves. (4) He places a translucent rice paper sheet on the board, wets it with water from a bowl, and carefully layers lettuce, cucumber, and beef before rolling it up. (5) After struggling with the first roll, he shows a plate with several finished rolls and begins eating them with a small dish of sauce in a dining area. (6) A brief cut shows a young toddler girl with pigtails sitting in a high chair in the background kitchen area. (7) The man is shown outdoors at night in a concrete yard, wearing a black t-shirt and showing an Apple Watch on his wrist with workout data. (8) He attempts to jump rope under artificial light, frequently tripping over the rope and showing visible frustration through facial expressions. (9) Back in the kitchen, he prepares a spicy duck blood dish, showing a large circular container of the ingredient and then slicing it into cubes. (10) He boils the duck blood in a pot on a gas stove, adds various spices, and then stirs the mixture in a ceramic bowl. (11) Finally, he sits at a table eating the spicy soup with rice, nodding in satisfaction as steam rises from the bowl. (12) The video concludes with a simple 2D animation of a boy and girl on a beige background.
